# Poster

Poster and flyer maker: event posters, flyers, sale announcements and menus generated with your headline and details spelled out correctly.

## What it does
Give the headline, the details (date, place, price) and the theme. Claude tells you the price and creates the design, portrait by default.

**How the files are made:** each poster is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Image files (PNG). Short, exact text works best.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install poster@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Poster talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/poster/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each poster uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The posters show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_poster_models` | Models for posters with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_poster_cost` | Exact price of one poster before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_poster` | Starts one poster in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_poster` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A retro poster for Jazz Night, Friday 8 pm at Blue Room, free entry"
- "A summer sale flyer: 30% off everything this weekend"
- "A minimal poster for a yoga retreat in Bali"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the poster (the headline, the details, the theme and the style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
